paper_metadata.title: Achieving high strength and high ductility in magnesium alloys using severe plastic deformation combined with low-temperature aging

evidence.quote: A novel method of fabricating age-hardenable magnesium alloys with high strength and high ductility was developed using high-ratio differential speed rolling combined with low-temperature aging.
